about: Hand-annotated shots: an annotated screenshot of a paused frame, tied to the exact frame of the source clip. `shot` is null until the person who annotated it says what the shot was; nothing here is inferred by the pipeline.

labels.camera: behind the batter; batter about 37% of frame height
labels.annotation: Green hooked arrow drawn at the bat's toe, starting low-right and curving to the right. Read as the bat's path / shot direction, finishing toward the right of the frame — interpretation NOT confirmed by the annotator.
labels.pose_note: At this frame the pose model finds torso and right arm, but both legs collapse into one column (viewed from behind) and the left arm/knees are low-confidence (0.24-0.49): front/back foot cannot be read.
